source_engines: Two-engine compilation (Gemini 3.8 + Claude), cross-verified against live reporting Sept 9, 2026. Disputed stat lines resolved to the box score of record: Moore 378 yds (AP), Maiava 48/54 (88.9%, 6 incompletions in 2 GP), Russell 18/30-256 (ESPN). Marcel Reed carries LOW confidence — his stat line did not verify independently in the second engine.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 27/30 (90.0%), 401 pass yds, 5 TD, 0 INT — 257.3 NCAA passer rating (Miami 45-6 Stanford)
contenders.case_for: Authored the weekend's best line — 401 yards and five scores on 30 attempts, no picks — and now leads a Miami offense built to pile up numbers. The outright market favorite controls the leading-man role for a top-10 team.
contenders.case_against: The +550 price banks a ceiling reached against overmatched Stanford, and Miami is a top-10 team rather than a title favorite — the historical Achilles' heel of Heisman front-runners.
contenders.next_test: vs. Florida A&M, Thursday, Sept. 10 (home). Measuring-stick game: at Notre Dame, Nov. 7.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 19/29 (65.5%), 239 pass yds, 2 TD, 0 INT (Notre Dame 41-13 Wisconsin, Lambeau Field)
contenders.case_for: The preseason co-favorite set Notre Dame's single-season passer-rating record as a redshirt freshman and is the centerpiece of a national-title contender with a clean path through an independent schedule.
contenders.case_against: His Sept. 5 numbers at DK/BetMGM predate an ordinary Wisconsin debut (239 yards, two scores); the current read is FanDuel's +1300. A run-first identity suppresses raw volume.
contenders.next_test: vs. Rice, Sept. 12 (home). The Nov. 7 Miami date is the season's referendum.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 20/27 (74.1%), 305 pass yds, 4 TD, 1 INT — 210.4 NCAA passer rating (Texas 59-7 Texas State)
contenders.case_for: A clean four-touchdown opener (210.4 rating) plus the schedule that hands him September's biggest stage. A win over No. 1 Ohio State vaults him to the front of the race.
contenders.case_against: He struggled against Ohio State in 2025 (56.7%, 170 yards, one TD, one INT) — this candidacy hinges almost entirely on Saturday night in Austin.
contenders.next_test: vs. No. 1 Ohio State, Sept. 12, 7:30 p.m. ET, ABC (home).

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 8 rec, 151 yds, 2 TD — first half only (Ohio State 56-3 Ball State)
contenders.case_for: The shortest-priced non-quarterback on the board posted 151 yards and two scores in a single half before resting. The most physically dominant receiver in the sport.
contenders.case_against: Only a handful of primary receivers have ever won the Heisman (Rodgers, Brown, Howard, D. Smith, Hunter), and he has been quiet against Texas historically — one catch for three yards in the Jan. 2025 CFP semifinal.
contenders.next_test: at No. 4 Texas, Sept. 12, 7:30 p.m. ET, ABC.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 21/36 (58.3%), 336 pass yds, 3 TD, 1 INT; 50 rush yds, 1 rush TD — four total TDs, all after halftime (Ole Miss 41-24 Louisville via 48-yard FG as time expired)
contenders.case_for: Delivered the only Week 1 win over a ranked opponent, leading a game-winning drive against then-No. 24 Louisville. On3's No. 3 (113 points) and the rare contender who already owns a quality win.
contenders.case_against: A 58.3% completion rate and an interception show he can be erratic; DraftKings' +1900 is a stale pre-Sunday number and FanDuel's +1100 is the accurate read.
contenders.next_test: vs. Charlotte, Sept. 12 (home). The Sept. 19 visit from LSU is an elimination bout with Leavitt.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 12 rec, 234 yds (school record; some outlets list 233), 3 TD — broke Eddie Brown's 220 from the 1984 Hail Flutie game (Miami 45-6 Stanford)
contenders.case_for: Set Miami's single-game receiving record and leads On3's post-Week 1 Heisman Poll with 146 points — ahead of every quarterback. Led the FBS with 109 catches and a school-record 1,211 yards in 2025.
contenders.case_against: No true wide receiver has won since Travis Hunter (2024, a two-way player); receiver candidacies rarely survive a full season of quarterback-heavy voting, and target dispersion caps volume.
contenders.next_test: vs. Florida A&M, Thursday, Sept. 10 (home); the measuring stick is at Notre Dame, Nov. 7.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 21/25 (84.0%), 320 pass yds, 3 pass TD + 1 rush TD, 0 INT — 231.1 NCAA passer rating (Ohio State 56-3 Ball State)
contenders.case_for: A 2025 Heisman finalist who led the nation in completion percentage opened with 84% and four total scores. Austin is his chance to prove he is the sport's best passer on the biggest September stage.
contenders.case_against: He shares the offense with Jeremiah Smith — ballot cannibalization is real — and he has been quiet in prior meetings with Texas.
contenders.next_test: at No. 4 Texas, Sept. 12, 7:30 p.m. ET, ABC.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 28/37 (75.7%), 378 pass yds (career high; some corrected reports list 388), 3 TD, 0 INT (Oregon 34-27 Boise State)
contenders.case_for: Threw for a career-high 378 and three scores and led the second-half surge past a game Boise State. Returned to Eugene rather than enter the draft and runs one of the sport's best offenses.
contenders.case_against: The offense sputtered early in a closer-than-expected win, and his price drifted despite the yardage — books and voters wanted more.
contenders.next_test: at Oklahoma State, Sept. 12 (Stillwater). Season-defining: at USC Sept. 26, at Ohio State Nov. 7.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 16/28 (57.1%), 230 pass yds, 1 TD, 1 INT; 12 car, 113 rush yds, 2 rush TD (LSU 51-10 Clemson)
contenders.case_for: The weekend's best dual-threat debut — 113 rushing yards, two ground scores, plus a passing TD — powered a 41-point rout of Clemson in Lane Kiffin's new offense.
contenders.case_against: Only 16 completions and an early pick show the passing game is a work in progress; the SEC gauntlet starts Sept. 19 at Ole Miss.
contenders.next_test: vs. Louisiana Tech, Sept. 12 (home); at Ole Miss, Sept. 19.

contenders.stat_line: 2 GP (incl. Week 0): 48/54 (88.9%), 635 pass yds, 5 TD, 0 INT; 1 rush TD — 23/25 for 349 and 3 TD vs. Fresno State
contenders.case_for: Almost untouchable across two games — 48-of-54, six incompletions total, five scores, no picks — running Lincoln Riley's offense at No. 8 in On3's poll.
contenders.case_against: Both wins came against overmatched Group of Five foes; the candidacy needs a signature Big Ten result, starting late September.
contenders.next_test: vs. Louisiana, Sept. 13 (home, closes non-conference); the Big Ten slate is the real test.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 13/16 (81.2%), 231 pass yds, 4 TD, 0 INT (Indiana 52-16 North Texas)
contenders.case_for: Ruthlessly efficient replacing 2025 Heisman winner Fernando Mendoza for the defending national champions; entered the year with the most returning passing yards (9,629) and TD passes (71) in the sport, per ESPN.
contenders.case_against: North Texas outgained Indiana, and his odds drifted after the win — the marquee schedule arrives late (Ohio State, Oct. 17).

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 11/17 (64.7%), 225 pass yds, 3 TD, 0 INT (Oklahoma 51-0 UTEP)
contenders.case_for: Clean shutout opener (three scores, no picks) in Ben Arbuckle's scheme, and an immediate national stage to make a statement.
contenders.case_against: Seventeen attempts against UTEP tell us little; the 2025 hand injury and inconsistency linger, and five ranked SEC foes test the line all year.
contenders.next_test: at Michigan, Sept. 12, noon ET, FOX; at Georgia looms Sept. 26.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 18/30 (60.0%), 256 pass yds, 0 pass TD, 0 INT; 13 car, 86 rush yds, 1 rush TD — 342 total yards (Alabama 48-10 East Carolina)
contenders.case_for: Accounted for 342 total yards in his first career start and set an Alabama debut record, flashing the five-star dual-threat traits in Kalen DeBoer's spread.
contenders.case_against: Zero passing touchdowns and a 60% clip show a ceiling not yet reached; durability from his running style is a real question entering SEC play.
contenders.next_test: at Kentucky, Sept. 12; Florida State visits Sept. 20.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 15/16 (93.8%), 202 pass yds, 3 TD, 0 INT — five drives (Georgia 63-3 Tennessee State)
contenders.case_for: Nearly perfect in limited work leading the No. 2 team; took a clear step from 2025 and distributes efficiently.
contenders.case_against: An FCS opponent and an early exit make the sample tiny; only DraftKings lists him, and Georgia's passing volume may stay modest.
contenders.next_test: vs. Western Kentucky, Sept. 12 (home); SEC play sharpens the picture.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 21/30 (70.0%), 233 pass yds, 2 TD, 0 INT; 7 car, 20 rush yds (Texas A&M 50-0 Missouri State) — stat line from a single reporting pass, pending independent verification
contenders.case_for: Poised command of a top-10 squad with three quarters of clean football; the dual-threat platform is there if the Aggies navigate the SEC slate.
contenders.case_against: Texas A&M's run-first identity limits aerial volume, and — full disclosure — his Week 1 line did not verify in the second research engine, hence the low confidence here.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 22/34 (64.7%), 354 pass yds, 4 TD, 0 INT; 6 car, 59 rush yds, 1 rush TD — 413 total yards, no turnovers (Mississippi State 62-13 ULM). On3 poll No. 6 (69 pts)
contenders.case_for: The nation's most explosive opener nobody priced — five total touchdowns and 413 yards without a turnover in Jeff Lebby's offense.
contenders.case_against: No major book lists him, reflecting Mississippi State's projected lower-half SEC finish; team-record headwinds historically derail dark horses.
contenders.next_test: vs. Arizona State, Sept. 12 (home); at Minnesota the week after.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 31/41 (75.6%), 453 pass yds, 7 TD, 0 INT — ACC single-game TD record; first 450+/7-TD/0-INT game since Joe Burrow 2019 (Pitt 59-14 Miami OH). On3 poll No. 9 (30 pts)
contenders.case_for: Led the nation in Week 1 passing with seven touchdowns to seven different receivers — statistically the most staggering opener in the country.
contenders.case_against: Pitt is unranked with no posted odds; he needs an unblemished run through ACC heavyweights to gain real traction.
contenders.next_test: vs. UCF, Sept. 12 (Acrisure Stadium); NC State follows.

contenders.stat_line: 1 GP: 14 car, 160 rush yds (11.4 YPC), 3 TD (Florida vs. Florida Atlantic). On3 poll No. 10 (29 pts)
contenders.case_for: Ruthless efficiency as the bellcow — 160 yards and three scores on 14 carries in Buster Faulkner's offense, after a 1,170-yard 2025.
contenders.case_against: Running backs need enormous volume and team success; Florida's ceiling is uncertain and no book lists him.
contenders.next_test: vs. Samford, Sept. 12 (home); the SEC opener follows.

notes: Team ranks are the AP Top 25 released Sept. 8, 2026. Odds are as reported by the named sportsbooks/outlets — never computed here; several Sept. 5 lines predate Sunday-night games and are flagged stale in-line. On3 poll points cited where applicable. STALENESS FLAG: Miami's Mensah and Toney play Thursday, Sept. 10, so their lines and stats change before Saturday — this board refreshes after Week 2. Also receiving On3 votes: Nate Sheppard (Duke RB), Jaylin Carter (Memphis RB), Kevin Jennings (SMU QB), Pop Watson (UMass QB), Trent Mosley (USC WR), Cam Coleman (Texas WR), Rocco Becht (Penn State QB), Xavier Gilliam (Tennessee DL).
